items.title: Fed raises policy rate 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% and signals more tightening
items.summary: First Fed hike in more than three years; 16 of 18 policymakers project at least one more hike in 2026. US10Y returned to about 5%. Dow -1.21%, S&P500 -0.44%, Nasdaq -0.01%.

items.title: BOJ expected to raise rate to 1.25% on Sep 18
items.summary: Reuters reports BOJ is set to lift the policy rate to a 31-year high as oil-driven inflation risk persists. Event pricing is already substantial.

items.title: Japan August imports surge 28% as oil costs lift trade deficit
items.summary: Imports rose 28% y/y and exports 19.3%; trade deficit was about ¥1.106tn. Energy inflation remains a domestic policy and margin risk.

items.title: Nikkei 225 futures night close 64,250, +410
items.summary: OSE Dec futures ended night session 410 points higher and 327 points above Sep16 cash close 63,923, despite US equity weakness after the Fed hike.

items.title: Mitachi raises H1 recurring profit 60% and full-year outlook
items.summary: Company revised H1 recurring profit sharply higher and also raised full-year guidance.

items.title: Densan raises H1 recurring profit forecast 2.6x
items.summary: FY27/3 H1 recurring profit forecast raised from ¥320m to ¥840m.

items.title: XNET raises H1 recurring profit 29%, full year and dividend
items.summary: H1 recurring profit +29% revision, full-year guidance raised and H1 dividend increased ¥5.

items.title: Kunimine raises H1 recurring profit 31% to five-year high and full year
items.summary: Fresh upward revision with record-level H1 profit profile.

items.title: Kringle Pharma signs exclusive Japan sales agreement with Maruishi
items.summary: Contract includes ¥100m upfront payment plus development milestones and post-launch royalties; loss forecast narrowed.

items.title: GENDA August sales +24.4% y/y
items.summary: Monthly sales maintained double-digit growth; requires margin and acquisition-quality follow-up before promotion beyond Fresh Catalyst.

items.title: Hmcomm files patent for drive-by infrastructure monitoring
items.summary: Technology uses logistics vehicles to collect data from measurement equipment such as inside manholes; revenue exposure not yet verified.

items.title: SpiderPlus and Uluru BPO launch paper-drawing digitization service for generative AI use
items.summary: Construction documents are digitized into AI-usable data assets. Direct revenue contribution is not disclosed.

items.title: Saudi pipeline disruption remains physical supply constraint though oil eased
items.summary: Brent fell to about $105.83 after Saudi offered additional crude via Oman, but physical route disruption remains unresolved.
